about_the_game:
Step Into a World of Soothing Satisfaction in Clean My Feet

After a long, demanding day, ladies' feet can get a little dirty. From sandy toes after a beach stroll, to mud-caked arches from gardening, or sweaty soles after an intense workout – that's where you come in. Clean My Feet puts you in the role of a meticulous foot specialist, transforming tired and dirty feet into sparkling perfection.

Featuring fully 3D characters and environments, you can dive in close as you rotate around their feet to clean them from every angle. But be careful - their feet are both sensitive and ticklish! Get their feet clean enough and you’ll unlock more ladies, locations, and tools.

Caravan of Characters

Featuring 12 different ladies with dirty feet, you're going to have your work cut out for you.

Tools of the Trade

You have a selection of different cleaning tools to work with, each with its own unique twist. Softer brushes are safer and less likely to hurt or tickle the ladies, but they take longer to clean. Heavier brushes will get the job done more quickly, but go slow, or you’ll wind up hurting their delicate soles.

Serene Settings

The ladies of Clean My Feet spend their days working out, tending to their greenhouse, or sunbathing at the beach, and after a long day their feet can get quite dirty. That’s where you come in.

Mix and match the ladies and locations in any way you’d like, but be careful not to hurt or tickle their feet!

Clean My Feet is coming soon - Wishlist it today!

content_descriptors.notes: Most characters wear revealing attire (i.e. bathing suits). There is also a bathtub sequence, though no nudity is shown.

detailed_description:
Now Available!

Clean My Feet is now available! We're excited to release our foot cleaning simulator to the world.

We have also uploaded an official button config for controller support - if you don't see it in the Community Layouts tab, be sure to toggle Show All Layouts (X on Steam Deck). And for you Mac users, the MacOS version is still planned for imminent release, so stay tuned.

Enjoy!

Minimum:
  • OS: 10.12 or Newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 5300M or Better on Intel, M1 or Better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: 10.15 or Newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or Newer
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
